Section located by MARKER not by the `## Evidence` heading — the unit suite carries the only input that can tell the two apart (a decoy `## Evidence` heading with no marker above it stays in `before`), which I confirmed is a genuine discriminator rather than a tautology. Missing closing block marker → EOF closes it, prose kept (unit). `after` returned and put back — verified live end-to-end: I appended a Traditional-Chinese artifact-language sentence below the closing marker, ran another round, and the sentence survived in place. [PASS] REQ-CLI-038 — `verify record --dimensions <file>` carries verdicts and evidence (one presentation defect worth fixing).
All 3 bullets hold. Both forms together → exit 1 with "--dimension and --dimensions are alternatives — one verify run has one verdict source" on stderr; nothing was written. `--dimension` only → behaviour unchanged and no verify.md created (confirmed on a change that had none, twice). `--dimensions` with prose → output ends "Judgment evidence: .prospec/changes/demo/verify.md"; prose-free → no path named and no file.
DEFECT (does not contradict the bullet, but reads wrong): the mutual-exclusion guard at src/cli/commands/verify-record.ts:82 throws commander's `InvalidArgumentError` from INSIDE the `.action()` handler. Commander only special-cases that class in option-parser callbacks, so it falls to `handleError` → `formatGenericError`, and the user sees "✗ An unexpected error occurred" followed by "InvalidArgumentError: --dimension and --dimensions are alternatives …". Exit is 1 and the sentence is present, so the requirement is met, but an intended refusal is presented as an internal crash — unlike every other refusal in this change, which renders as "✗ <message>" + "→ <suggestion>" via PrerequisiteError. Note the identical guard ALSO exists in verify-record.service.ts as a PrerequisiteError and renders correctly; the CLI-layer throw shadows it. One-line fix: raise PrerequisiteError there, or delete the CLI check and let the service's fire. Repro: `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts verify record --change demo --dimension delta-spec-compliance=PASS --dimensions <file>` in a scratch project.

=== RE-GRADE (round 2): the two WARN drivers, re-checked ===

SCOPE: only the two items my WARN rested on, per the coordinator's direction. The other 11 REQs were not re-audited; REQ-CLI-038 and REQ-CLI-029 are the only REQs whose text moved, and both are covered below. --- ITEM 1: SC-006's stale token figures — FIXED, verified digit-for-digit ---
I re-derived every figure myself rather than trusting the record, using `estimateTokens` from src/lib/token-accounting.ts (which self-reports `chars-per-token:4`), comparing `git show HEAD:<path>` against the working tree. Measured: prospec-review.hbs 3,261 -> 3,549 = +288; prospec-verify.hbs 10,153 -> 10,398 = +245; the reference 2,161 tokens as .hbs and 2,136 as deployed .md. I measured the deployed .md in ALL FOUR locations (.claude and .agents, review and verify) and every copy is 2,136 — so the single recorded deployed number is not an average or a lucky pick.
Recorded now in proposal.md SC-006: "部署後 2,136 tokens，仍在 reference 的 2,500 預算內", "+288（3,261 → 3,549）", "+245（10,153 → 10,398）". Every one matches my measurement exactly, and the 2,136 < 2,500 reference-budget claim is true. tasks.md's measurement table (lines 66-69) carries the same three corrected figures plus the .hbs 2,161, all matching. Both places now state the numbers are a re-measurement taken after the review rounds, and tasks.md line 73 names precisely what grew the reference (the Trust boundary section, the `id`/`lens` ceiling rows, the closing-marker example) and credits the 2/5 grader with catching it — an honest provenance note, not a silent overwrite. The relaxed ≤300/file threshold still holds on the true numbers (+288, +245), and the SC still describes itself as RELAXED rather than met, which was the part that was already honest.
RESIDUAL (disclosed, not blocking): two tasks.md CHECKLIST lines still carry the superseded figures unqualified — T12 (line 34) "實測 +238" and T24 (line 49) "實測 +278／+238". They are historical work-log entries and T24 explicitly points the reader at the measurement section below ("見下方量測節"), which supersedes them and explains why they went stale; so the document self-corrects and no graduating claim is wrong. Still, they are the same class of defect in the same artifact, and the cheapest possible fix is marking them superseded. Worth doing before archive; not worth holding the dimension for.

--- ITEM 2: REQ-CLI-038's refusal rendered as an internal error — FIXED, and the overreaching bullet corrected ---
Mechanism: the action-level throw is gone; `--dimensions` is now declared with `new Option(...).conflicts('dimension')` in src/cli/commands/verify-record.ts, so the argument parser owns the refusal. The service-layer PrerequisiteError guard is untouched at src/services/verify-record.service.ts:165 and its unit test ("refuses both verdict forms at once") still passes.
I ran `pnpm build` first and drove the compiled `dist/cli/index.js` from a NEWLY created scratch project (my earlier scratch had been overwritten by another process at 00:03, so I rebuilt it rather than trusting stale fixtures), capturing stdout and stderr to separate files so no pipeline could mask an exit code:
  (a) both forms, --dimension first: exit 1, stdout EMPTY, stderr = "error: option '--dimensions <file>' cannot be used with option '--dimension <spec>'" + "(use --help for additional information)". No "An unexpected error occurred" anywhere.
  (b) both forms with the flags in the opposite order: identical message and exit — the refusal is not order-dependent.
  (c) `--dimensions` ALONE: exit 0, graded, "Judgment evidence: .prospec/changes/demo/verify.md" printed, and verify.md present on disk. This is the regression that mattered — `--dimension` carries a `[]` default, and a conflicts check keyed on the VALUE rather than on the source would have refused every file-form run. Commander keys on the option source, so the default does not count as supplied. Confirmed empirically, not inferred.
  (d) `--dimension` alone (all three flags): exit 0, status line normal, no verify.md path named — the smaller grammar is untouched.
Corrected bullet, judged against (a): "THEN the command refuses with a usage error naming BOTH options, rather than silently preferring one — the conflict is declared to the argument parser, so the refusal reads as the usage mistake it is instead of as an unexpected internal error." Every clause is now true and was previously not: it IS a usage error (commander's `error:` + the --help hint), it DOES name both options in full, and it no longer reads as an internal error. The old wording ("says that the two forms are alternatives") would have been FALSE against this message — commander says "cannot be used with", not "alternatives" — so correcting the bullet was necessary, not cosmetic, and it corrects an overreach in the direction of LESS claim rather than more.
REQ-CLI-029's matching bullet was corrected too and I checked it as well: "THEN the command refuses with a usage error naming both options — one round has one verdict source — and refuses again in the service, so a programmatic caller cannot bypass the grammar." Both halves verified: the parser refusal in (a), and the service refusal by the still-present guard plus its passing unit test. I re-read REQ-CLI-029's whole `**Spec:**` block after the edit and all four pre-existing trust-zone bullets are still reproduced verbatim — the correction did not disturb the no-silent-drop property I verified in the first pass.
The E2E guard was tightened along with the fix and is well made: it pins "cannot be used with option '--dimension <spec>'" — the full spec including the closing quote, which is what distinguishes `--dimension <spec>` from `--dimensions <file>` and would catch a self-referential `.conflicts('dimensions')` typo — and adds a negative assertion that stderr does NOT contain "unexpected error". Both cases pass against fresh dist/.

`pnpm test` 3741 passed / 4 skipped / 149 files; `pnpm typecheck` clean; `pnpm lint` clean (the `InvalidArgumentError` import is still used by `parseJudgmentDimension`, so removing the action throw left no dead import); `pnpm counts:check` "factual counts are in sync"; `pnpm agents:check` "generated artifacts are current (104 files)". === FINAL VERDICT ===
PASS. Both WARN drivers are genuinely fixed, not papered over. The SC-006 figures now match my own independent re-measurement exactly in every place that carries them, including the deployed .md across all four deployment targets, and the record additionally explains why the first measurement went stale — which is stronger than merely being right. The mutual-exclusion refusal is now a parser-level usage error naming both options with an empty stdout and no crash headline, the file-form-alone path is proven not to regress, and the REQ bullets that described it were corrected DOWNWARD to match what commander actually says rather than left overreaching. Nothing new was introduced: all six gates are green and the smaller `--dimension` grammar behaves exactly as before. Across the dimension, all 13 REQs' bullets are honoured, no MODIFIED block silently drops a shipped bullet, and no code contradicts any bullet. Two non-blocking notes carry forward to archive: tasks.md's T12/T24 checklist lines still cite the superseded +278/+238 figures unqualified (the measurement section below them supersedes and explains them), and `renderEvidenceSection` still trusts its caller to vet a supplied section heading — guarded today only by verify-record's own `isUnsafeRawLine` check plus commander's ISO-date parser, with no test standing guard for the next caller.

### constitution — WARN

**Summary:** 8/8 條規則逐一稽核（清單與嚴重度取自引擎，未自行重列或改判）：7 條 PASS，1 條 WARN —— [MUST] INVEST 的 S 偏弱。

規則清單由 structural.constitution.rules[] 供給（8 條），逐條 1:1 稽核如下。嚴重度一律取自清單。

1. [MUST] Language Policy — PASS。五份變更工件皆繁中（proposal 64／plan 89／delta-spec 51／tasks 75／review 14 行含 CJK）；delta-spec 的 13 個 `**Spec:**` 區塊 0 個含 CJK（具名反向例外：它們逐字落進信任區）；本變更觸及的信任區檔案（六份 module README、station-engines.md、新 reference）grep 不到任何 CJK。

2. [MUST] Atomic Commits and Format — PASS（格式義務延後）。HEAD 仍在 f1dfad5：implement 與 review 全程未 commit，正是契約要求；51 個路徑會在 S/A 提示處落成單一 feature commit。Conventional Commits／英文／bullet body／無 AI co-authorship 這四項在該 commit 才可觀察，屆時由提示強制。

3. [MUST] User Stories Follow INVEST — WARN。六項逐一：I 弱但成立（US-4 verify grader 本就被當作可獨立退場的槓桿，US-1～3 共用 schema 因此相依）；N 成立（上限 200→300→500/600 三次協商、範圍協商過）；V 成立；E 成立（26 任務含估算）；**S 偏弱**（6 模組／13 REQ／26 任務）；T 成立（每個 story 有明文 AC 與獨立測試）。判 WARN 而非 FAIL 的理由：S 的判準是「可在單次迭代內完成」，而它確實在單次迭代內落地 —— 故非違規。但這條 WARN 是實質的：這個尺寸直接產出四輪 42 個 review 發現，正是該判準存在要警告的成本。ff 站已先記過同一條。

4. [MUST] Test-Driven Development — PASS。每個 code 任務與其測試在同一工作樹（單一 commit）落地；3,741 tests passed（`--record-tests` 記為事實，exit 0）；覆蓋率 Statements 94.45%(6283/6652)／Lines 94.99%／Functions 95.09%／Branches 89.46%，全部遠高於 ≥80% 門檻；我改動的 `types/station.ts` 為 100%。額外證據：三輪共 23 個變異全數 KILLED —— 斷言是可被證偽的，不只是存在。

5. [SHOULD] One-way Dependency Direction — PASS。逐檔檢查本變更觸及的 src/*.ts：無任何向上 import（types 不 import lib/services/cli，lib 不 import services/cli，services 不 import cli）。新增的 `lib/delegated-evidence.ts` **零 import**，是真正的葉節點；`markdown-fences`／`markdown-table` 皆未 import 它，無 lib→lib 循環。`trimTrailingNewlines` 從 markdown-table 移到 markdown-fences 正是為了避免 content-merger 為一個字串修剪去 import 表格引擎（round 3 的 R2-7）。

6. [SHOULD] User-Facing Documentation Stays Current — PASS。`review merge` 與 `verify record` 兩列 CLI 表格在 README.md 與 README.zh-TW.md 同步更新（新增 evidence 落地與 `--dimensions`）；source-tree 區塊的 reference 計數 19→22 雙語同動 —— 那個 19 是既有的錯值，由 review 的 Q-6 抓出。雙語 parity 維持。

7. [MUST] Factual Count Integrity — PASS。機器擁有：`pnpm counts` 已跑、`pnpm counts:check` 綠。手維護三族逐一重導：`src/lib/*.ts` 實際 39＝lib README 宣稱 39；references 實際 22＝兩份 README 宣稱 22；`.hbs` 實際 67＝module-map 宣稱 67。lib README 的算式亦精確吻合：6 drift ＋ 6 station ＋ 11 具名 ＋ 16 helpers ＝ 39。其中「16 helpers」是 review 的 A-4／Q-5 抓到的錯（我曾誤改成 17）。

8. [MUST] Pre-Merge CI Checks — PASS。六項全綠：`pnpm lint`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm test:coverage`（exit 0，≥80%）、`pnpm counts:check`、`pnpm agents:check`、`prospec check --strict`（17/17 checks，**0 fail**／3 warn —— warn 不影響 exit code）。
